quotes.quote: **Hy4 preview** is a new-generation Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) flagship model developed by the Tencent Hy Team. The model comprises 770B total parameters, of which 49B are activated per token.
In addition to the backbone, 1 native MTP layer (10B total parameters, 0.7B activated) is built in for speculative decoding.
The table below lists backbone parameters only, excluding the MTP layer.
We partnered with top experts inside Tencent — such as software engineers, game developers, finance analysts, and security experts — and built training data around the work they ship.
## Benchmark Appendix

We open-source **Hy4 preview** and **Hy4 preview-FP8** model weights on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-preview), [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-preview)

To ground Hy4 in real-world financial work, we built thousands of realistic workspaces and tens of thousands of tasks spanning fund research, equity analysis, quantitative strategies, asset allocation, corporate finance, and tax accounting.
Working with Tencent Financial Technology (FiT), we evaluated Hy4 with 213 finance professionals, including 153 experts from leading financial institutions.
Across 579 real-world financial tasks, Hy4 ranks first among open-weight models
## Appendix: benchmark results
